The abstract describes an LLM-based agent that uses RAG to enhance exosome-related knowledge. The system is built and evaluated (the FFT classifier reports accuracies), and RAG is a component of the interactive agent. The rules ask whether the paper runs experiments with a RAG system. RAG is used here, but the abstract reports no RAG-specific evaluation. The rules say not to exclude just because baselines or metrics are missing. The paper proposes a system that includes RAG, so it is not clearly out of scope. It is borderline, so INCLUDE or MAYBE both fit, and I lean toward INCLUDE because the system uses RAG, though MAYBE is also defensible. Because RAG is only a minor component and the experiments reported concern the Raman classifier, I choose MAYBE.

{"decision": "MAYBE", "code": null, "reason": "LLM agent uses RAG, but reported experiments concern the Raman classifier; RAG evaluation unclear."}
